Smoke test: load latex and parse a simple snippet

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"latex\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "\\documentclass{article}\n\\begin{document}\nHello\n\\end{document}", config: configObj)
print(result)
```
